summary:
- LangGraph: LangGraph orchestrates stateful workflows using nodes, edges and shared state. It supports checkpointing, streaming, human approval and durable execution. It is suitable for controlled enterprise workflows. [LG01]
- CrewAI: CrewAI coordinates specialized agents through roles, tasks and crews. Flows provide event-driven orchestration, state management and persistence for production applications. [CA01]
- AutoGen: AutoGen supports conversational multi-agent collaboration and message-based execution. The project is archived and Microsoft recommends Microsoft Agent Framework for new implementations. [AG01]
- Claude Agent SDK: Claude Agent SDK provides an autonomous agent loop, built-in tools, MCP integration, sessions, permission controls, hooks and usage monitoring. [CL01]
